balls.text: Slot on off, 136ks, tries to force a drive. Gets it along the ground to mid-off's left. Buttler stops it with a slide across, it's a half-stop actually. Allows the second to be taken. A bit of an awry throw creates a minor collision between Madhwal and Samson, who was well in front. All good though
Yorker on leg, worked to long-on
Tries to pull it but gets it to deep point. Hard length around off, went from just below the sticker. Pandya shown smiling. Crowd were quiet for a moment... before booing

Top edges it but Bumrah's holding onto a stable base. Hard length, 131ks, just over the stumps. Bumrah had all stumps exposed and tried to clobber it across the line. Lands safely and goes to long-on. Just a single
Connects with the pull. Is it in the gap? Yep, Jaiswal wasn't too far, he dove to the right and but got yorked and couldn't get hand on it. Was a bumper, pace on.
Ouch. Bashed into a length at 137ks, on off, beats the pull and deflects off the thigh pad to the offside. Single stolen
Bumper beats the pull. 122ks, Bumrah too ealy on the shot
Into the pitch, at the body. Tries to defend straight, bat-pad, goes into the pitch. Doesn't go far from the crease
Full on middle and leg, blocked to the bowler's right

David can't finish on a high. Burger goes into the pitch, angles in at the body. It's pulled from deep in the crease, flat and to Boult at the long-leg boundary, who takes it just while jogging to the right. Maybe David was expecting the slower one too there
Wide yorker, slapped to deep cover
David will farm strike now. Shortish at the body, cramped on the pull. Deflects off the body to backward square leg
Short again, pulled uppishly with limited timing. Rolls to deep square leg. Single not taken this time, so David will get strike for next over's start
Pulls the shortish ball to the deep on the leg side. Not sure why he go for boundaries here
Well, he defends it to cover. Three-quarter length on leg, punched it against the line of the ball too.
Bumper. Very short, 125ks, over middle. Around face-height, David sways back inwards to let it go
Hard length over leg, blocked to the bowler
Goes for the pull, french cuts it past leg peg. Deep fine leg runs to the right, slides and stops it. Was a length ball, think he made a bit of room
He takes a single off the last ball. Somewhat surprising given David in strike for the next over's start wasn't the worst option. Was full around fifth, worked to long-on
Fullish on leg, knocked in front.
Full on fourth, Bumrah lunges far forward to smother it. Does so despite not completely getting to the pitch

Softie to cover. Chahal winning the invitational with a 76ks legbreak. Fullish, lands around fifth and turns away a bit. Coetzee looked to drive on the up, didn't try and muscle it but ended up spooning it Hetmyer
Gorgeous loopy invite. Fullish, lands outside off and rips away, Coetzee happy to let it go
Length on leg, flat, beats the flick and hits flush on the pad. Would've gone down leg
Length just outside off, punched off the back foot with an open face, to deep point

Makes room and tries to belt it over cover. Misses, Samson can only half-stop it. He runs towards fine leg and that brings the single. Was a shortish ball following him. Samson slid while picking up the ball which, as Matthew Hayden notes, could be a sign of dew
Length on off, opens the face and guides to deep point
Slot at this stage. Fifth-stump, angling in, muscled but not middled. Goes to deep cover
Wide and full, jams a drive to deep cover
Overpitched and angling in on the pads. David was across to off and was able to clip it with ease. Four to backward square
Wide yorker lands just inside the return crease. Let go
Fullish on leg, 90ks, clipped to midwicket
Full on leg, driven to long-on
Given air after going flat. Full around off, driven to long-off. MI's 100 is up, music and announcer go up, crowd not as much
Length on leg, clipped to midwicket off the backfoot
Length on sixth, stands firm and carves it to deep point
Looks like RR might take the option of milking singles off him. David stays in the crease and slaps the length ball outside off, to cover, for a single
Full on leg, worked to midwicket. Like RR, MI take the timeout a couple overs early
Full on leg, 84ks, punched to long-on
Flat on a length, 98ks, on off, front leg slides out the way as he punches it to cover
Length on off, 86ks, stabbed off the back foot towards point for a quick single

RR don't have to worry about Tilak farming strike anymore as Chahal gets him with a wide ball. On a length, had him reach out. Might've even been wide had he left it but he committed to the cut. Googly too, which meant it spun away further, the edge was found and the ball ballooned to short third's left. Good leaping take from Ashwin
Wide and shortish, clears the front leg and tries slapping it. Bat face turns and it goes into the pitch
Full on leg, clipped to deep midwicket. 88ks. Tilak negotiated that over well
Length outside off, punched to cover
Smart from Tilak. Deep square leg and midwicket were far, so he tucked it off the pads right in the middle and slow enough that they had to travel, giving him time to take two
Good two taken again. Great ball too, full around fourth, given a bit of air. Tilak tried to push it to mid-off and got a thick inside edge. Ball rolled gently to midwicket
Looped up full, driven from off to long-off
Yeah, a bit of air. Length on fourth, defended from deep in the crease and is defended in front
Wide on a length, crunched to deep point
Wide and shortish, slapped to the right of deep cover. Two bouncers for the over done
Hard length, decks back in towards leg from off, 135ks. Punched back to the bowler
Bumper shoots up over mddle. David sways inwards. Wide given
Wide and shortish, slapped to the left of mid-off. Very bottom-hand heavy
Pitched up on middle and leg, flicked wide of long-on

Hetmyer takes a stunner at point. Reaches out to the right and takes it with both hands outstretched, around shoulder-height. Was not that short, around fifth stump and Chawla smashed it. Deep cut if it can be called one, was travelling fast. It's why Samson leapt over Hettie in delight in celebrations
Pushes the fullish ball on off to cover

Confident shout for strangled down leg. Wide given, Samson reviews. Length ball just down leg, Chawla tried to glance it with bat well in front of the body. There's a bit of chat going on - it's probably whether the review was for the wide or the wicket. The review is successful in the end as the umpire signals it. It's a fair ball in the end
Makes room, gets followed again but this one's around top-of-pad height - bit shorter - and he pulls it around the corner
Down leg, the length ball goes past the glance. Good take by Samson
Two stolen to midwicket. Was tucked off the pads and the skipper wanted the fielder to hurry but the batter was too quick
Makes room and gets followed from around the wicket. 87ks offbreak on a length, all he can do is work it forward
Fullish on middle and off, nudged to square leg
Wide on a fullish length, Tilak reaches out and cuts it off the bottom of the bat, to cover
Length on fifth, 94ks, steered to deep point
Length on fifth, flat stuff, beats the cut

Chahal has Hardik hole out! 86ks but flattish, landed around middle and leg and Hardik stood in the crease and tried to club it over long-on. Front leg was out of the way, could he have danced down to that? Got it off the bottom, Powell moved to the right and took a stumbling catch.
Ohmegawd how'd that miss off stump?! Darted at 94ks, landed around fourth and went straight. Hardik might have expected it to turn and got beaten
Length outside off, cut to deep point
Ashwin tries to keep it out of Hardik's hitting arc but the carrom ball is too short. Sits up for the muscly cut through cover

Tight tight second, throw is a bit off. Hardik hares in. Sent upstairs, he's made it in. Was a wide ball that was chopped to the left of Jaiswal this time, the throw was a bit too wide to Samson's right, so he had to swing his arms back in which allowed Hardik the time to slide the bat inside the crease
Slapped well, deep cover - Jaiswal - charges to the right and saves two. He dove full length, parried it, came back and threw it. Was a fullish wide ball that was powered wristily
Full outside off, driven to long-off
Dances down, small step and he's to the pitch, stays legside and slaps it to cover
Fullish around off, punched to long-off
Full on middle, pushed to long-on
Full on leg, Chahal probs looking for the magic ball there but gets no turn. Deadbatted in front
Waits for it to turn and carves it wide of slip. It went off the edge but seemed intentional given how late he played. Was a length ball, Hardik lunged and snapped his wrists with speed
Full on leg, strides forward and tries to smother it towards mid-on. Thick edge takes it towards cover point
Legbreak beats the cover drive with sharp spin. Lands around off on a length, flat trajectory, goes through fifth stump. Pandya went with the flurry
Length at the stumps, clipped to square leg
Guided wide of deep third. Decent ball, fifth stump and on a length, Pandya wristily stirred it, played it late and along the ground. Timeout taken
Pitched up around off, driven to mid-off for a quick single
Tilak goes hooky street. He expected the bouncer, got back and inside the line - with a few steps across - and helped it back over fine leg for a biggie - distance-wise too
Makes room and gets bounced. Good gas and direction from Avesh. Zips over fourth stump and Tilak has to pull out of playing it
Touch back of length if at all but Tilak reads it early, rocks back and pulls it over midwicket. Not middled, rolls to the right of Burger it looked like, running from deep fine leg
Three-quarter length around fifth, chopped off the underedge. Into the ground, to point
Thick outside edge off the attempted straight drive goes to the right of deep third.

Hardik's making a play to amend the powerplay. Dances down and slaps it over mid-on. More an indication of intent again. Charged to a length ball and heaved across, got it off the bottom but in-field clearing is all that's needed at this stage
Back to the bouncer. Around fourth stump, pulled into the ground, to midwicket
Walking into it again, thumps it into the ground and it blazes to the cover-point boundary.
Slammed over point and the crowd does cheer. Risk coming off there. Hardik charges to the length ball and tries to flay it more over cover. Got a thickish edge but enough power
Shortish just under the ribs, pulled with a swivel into the grass. Rolls through midwicket

Launched up, more height than distance, Chahal runs back from midwicket and can't reach it!. He was on the run while stretching forward but got no hand on it. Was a fullish ball that he tried launching more over mid-on, Bat-face turned
Length on off, defended in front
Width there and Tilak flays it over cover.
Length around off, defended in front
Jaffa again. Length on off, slight wobble of the seam, Tilak tried defending it but was beaten all ends up
Second six of the day in that fashion. Erring on line has been cashed in consistently as is the case here. Fullish, down leg and it's helped up and over fine leg
Three-quarter length on leg, blocked from the crease. Weight on both feet, blocked to midwicket
Fullish ball has been worked to midwicket
Yorker first up. Pacy and around off, he'd taken a step across and managed to jam it down

This is Test-match cricket, says Sanjay Manjrekar on air, and that's pretty much it. Bolt-upright seam, good - nay - perfect length. Lands around off, straightens off the deck and Kishan tries punching it straight. The movement finds the outside edge and the keeper takes it. A bit of extra bounce too that had Kishan hopping. Burger leaps in delight.
Too full and a bit of room allow Kishan to cream it through cover
Full around off, punched down the ground
Length on leg, clipped to midwicket
Searching for the ball, body's still but hands fish out to push the sixth stump three-quarter length ball to cover
Length outside off, let go
Boult misses the line and Tilak helps it fine. Fullish and on the outer-half of the pad, easy glance. Burger put in a full-fledged dive to the right from deep fine leg to stop two

Loose shot, taken at short third! Three in four for the lightning Boult that strikes thrice. Length on fifth, Brevis' front stride to a ball angling away meant it was outside his reach for an off-drive.
Length around sixth, swung away and was guided with the movement to deep point

Lbw call, looked tight on first view. Not given, no review. Pitched up, fuller side of length, angled in towards middle and beat the straight drive. Angle might've taken it down leg. Hawk-Eye prediction comes a ball later, says it'd have gone on to hit leg peg!

Into the body, induces a grunt from Kishan who's gloved it past Samson's right. Valiant dive but the angle took it further away. 145+ks, back of length, angling just down leg. Kishan tried hooking it but was done for pace.
Wide and back of length, Kishan reaches out for the cut but misses
Strangle chance? No, given wide. Shortish down leg, Kishan swivelled and went for the fine pull
Goes for another pick up, misses. In Kishan's half, angling in towards leg at 143ks, may have nicked it but went to pad
Pitched up on fourth, no swing, punched back to the bowler. Camera pans to Rohit, who's looking up into the middle distance in the dressing room
Picked up, deposited over long leg. Two wickets don't faze Kishan, this was a gimme too. Slot ball angling down leg, helped over with east

Lightning Boult strikes twice! Given out lbw but it's been reviewed. On a length again but this one comes in. Naman tried pushing it towards mid-on but the movement meant there was a big gap between bat and ball. Hit on the knee-roll while on the front foot. Hawk-Eye shows it'd go on to clip leg stump. Two in two to end the over. He'll be on a hat-trick for the start of his next over?

Edged and taken first ball! What a ball to silence the crowd! 132ks, scrambled-seam, on a length, lands around off and goes through the channel. It opens up Rohit on the straight-bat defence and takes the outside edge. Low carry to Samson's right but he dives and takes it well
Three-quarter length on fifth, guided to deep third
Kishan takes a step down but doesn't get much room. He cuffs the length ball with a cross bat, doesn't get all of it. Goes to cover
Punched to mid-on. Moves away in the air a bit, good length at 132ks, played from in front of off.
Back of length, touch of away movement. Good bounce, dabbed with the swing off the back foot, towards cover
Top edge as he tries to pull a short ball goes over the keeper and earns Royals the win!

Pulled over midwicket for back-to-back fifties! Dug in back of a length at 141kph, Parag gets it high in the air with a short-arm jab and just clears the rope. What a knock from him. Never looked troubled!
Carved over cover for six! Full and wide, Parag flays it inside out. Fast hands! Parag is now in a hurry to finish
On a length on middle and leg, Parag nudges it away through midwicket
Tucks it through midwicket for an easy single
Has a swing, but misses. Tossed full and flat outside off, slips under the bat
Tossed up full, Parag drills it out to long-off
Slogged over cow corner! Massive hit. In the slot on middle, Parag is not letting that one go. Dispatches it into the crowd
Tossed up outside off, Dubey lofts a drive on the bounce to long-off
Length ball around off, Parag is happy to defend and see Bumrah off
Short ball on middle and going down leg, Parag ducks as the umpire calls wide
Length ball on off, parried towards midwicket
Excellent shot. Bumrah goes for a yorker just outside off, but it's not quite there. Parag thrashes a drive through extra cover
Bouncer outside off, wide enough for Parag to leave it alone
Full on the pads, clipped in the air through the vacant square leg area
Length ball outside off, Parag opens the face and steers it past a diving backward leg fielder
Back foot punch through extra cover! Length ball, angling in from outside off as Madhwal goes around the wicket. Stands tall and pushes it in the gap. Lovely shot
Length ball around off, punched down the ground to long-on
Yorker outside off, squeezed out to backward point
Length ball angles in from outside off, Dubey works it through midwicket for his first run

Madhwal has his third! Short ball jags in from outside off. Ashwin looks to turn it leg side but gets a leading edge that goes high in the air. Tilak takes a good catch running back from backward point. Did well to settle under that skier. Madhwal strikes again in his last over
Full and wide, Parag goes for the drive and gets an edge that runs to Bumrah at deep third
Full on middle, Parag digs it out to long-off's left
Lovely delivery. Tossed up outside off, turns away slightly as Parag pushes at it and misses
On a length outside off, Ashwin backs off and slaps it out to deep point
Parries a full ball back to the bowler
Ashwin leans forward and across to try and drive away a full delivery tossed up wide of off. Can't get anything on it
Length ball on off, eased to long-off
Lucky inside edge! Short ball outside off at 142.8kph. Ashwin is late onto the pull and gets an inside edge that goes past the stumps and runs away fine on the leg side for four
Back of length delivery outside off cut away through point
On a length outside off, pushed out to sweeper cover
Back of length delivery, Parag misses his pull and is hit on the thigh
Driven on the up! Length ball outside off, Parag goes inside out and straight of sweeper cover, who stood no chance of stopping that
Dipping yorker on off, Parag brings his bat down to block it. Coetzee thinks it hit his toe before it hit the bat, but they don't review. Replays show it was indeed bat first
Length ball cut to point
Tossed up full, Parag goes across and drives it out square of the deep cover fielder
Pushed through on middle, Parag turns it square on the leg side
Length ball around off, punched to short cover
Tossed up full on off, Ashwin leans forward and eases it to long-off
Starts by pitching it on a length outside off, Parag works it away to deep midwicket
On a length outside off, Ashwin stands tall on the back foot and punches it through cover
Length ball has Ashwin driving but he can't connect. The ball bounces just in front of Kishan and deflects to his right off him. Kishan gives chase and collects
Clipped to deep midwicket for a single
Carved over the point fielder! Length ball outside off, Ashwin drives with the full face but gets it straight of, and above, the fielder
On a length on middle, Parag punches it out to deep midwicket
Length ball on middle, Ashwin clips it wide of mid-on for a single
Dug in back of a length around off, Ashwin tucks it to deep fine leg
Clipped fine on the leg side for a single. On a length on middle and that was going down leg. Parag eases it fine
Blocked back to the bowler. That was on a length at 141.3kph
Short ball angled across him and he swivels and just gets some bat on it for a boundary through fine leg
Lovely ramp! Bouncer outside off at 133.5kph angling in at Parag, who sways away and plays it over the keeper. Deep third was quite square so it was a safe shot
Back of length ball just outside off and angling in. Parag steers it to backward point
Length ball on off, worked down the ground to long-on. Fifty runs up for Royals
Full length ball outside off, driven on the up through cover to the sweeper fielder's right
Length ball outside off, Ashwin negotiates it safely, pushing it to cover
Pulled straight to deep fine leg! Bouncer on off at 134kph, Buttler looks for the pull, but hits it flat and straight to Piyush Chawla who makes no mistake.
ON a length outside off, straightens after pitching. Parag gets it off the outside half of the bat as it goes towards cover
Length ball outside off at 135kph, clipped to midwicket off the inside half of the bat
Spicy! 136kph bouncer outside off, Parag sways out of the way of that one
Goes for a yorker outside off, Parag pushes it towards cover where Hardik makes a good stop. Gets some applause from Rohit Sharma. That was another inswinger from Bumrah
Full outside off, a hint of swing away still, Parag blocks and the ball rolls to mid-off
Inducker on a length outside off. Parag is watchful and defends
On a length outside off at 141kph, Buttler taps it towards mid-on and they get a single away
Full around off at 136kph, Parag looks to play it to the leg side but gets a leading edge through backward point
Length ball outside off, punched to cover off the back foot
Buttler swings at thin air! Dug in short outside off, the ball jags away as Buttler looks to pull it away
Pitched up full, but very wide. Buttler was pressing towards it but checks his shot late even as it's called wide
On a length outside off, Buttler moves across and jabs at it. The ball goes off the leading edge to cover
Length ball angling down leg, Parag nudges it through to deep midwicket to get off the mark
Samson chops on! Madhwal bowls it short of good length outside off, Samson looks for a cut with no foot movement. Gets an underedge onto the stumps. Can this be a turning point?
Full around off, Buttler clips it through midwicket

Gets the edge, but wide of slip! Perfect outswinger, pitched up outside off. Samson looks to defend but gets a thick edge. But it's well wide of first slip. Even a second slip might not have stopped that. Samson picks up a boundary
Full outside off and swinging away. But bowled too wide
Length ball angles in from outside off, Buttler tucks it square on the leg side
Another gem from Bumrah! On a length outside off, Buttler shoulders arms, but the ball jags in sharply. Goes over the stumps and it's a good take by Kishan diving to his left
Length ball bowled well wide of off and seaming away wildly. Umpire calls it a wide

Has Hardik taken a screamer here? Oh no, it's popped out of his hands as he tries to take it low! Full outside off, Buttler drives it hard and Hardik dives to his left. Gets his hands to it, but can't hold on. Cue some jeers, but that was an excellent, excellent effort
Beauty! Outswinger just short of good length outside off, Buttler wafts at it but is beaten on the edge
Strays onto the pads and it's too full. Buttler clips it away through midwicket and finds the gap
Slightly fuller, but width on offer. Same result as the last ball. Samson opens the face to drive it square on the off side
Sees some width and latches on! Length ball going across Samson, and he slaps it through point past a diving fielder and it races away for four. Opens his account after six dot balls
Appeal for lbw as a length ball swings into Samson to hit him on the back pad. Mumbai Indians don't review. This could have pitched outside leg and height also a factor
Length ball on the pads, Buttler clips it away and square leg can't stop it. Deep backward square runs across to stop the boundary
Well bowled, and well countered by Buttler! Goes for the yorker on the stumps, but maybe doesn't get it quite full enough. Buttler squeezes it out through cover with an open face
Peach of a delivery Full outside off, swinging in, Buttler pokes at it only to see the ball fly past his outside edge
Full around off, 138kph, Samson defends watchfully
Full outside off, shaping away, Samson brings his bat down leg to tap it to backward point
Outswinger, fuller this time outside off, Samson shoulders arms
Another booming inswinger flies down leg side. Kishan can't stop this one as it goes away for five wides
Bumrah is getting the ball to talk! Outswinger outside off on a length. Samson pokes at it but is beaten on the outside
And now the one that moves away! Back of good length, outside off, it pitches and straightens as Samson plays inside the line
Another nip-backer! Jags back in sharply from outside off. Buttler gets squared up as the ball pops to the off side off his pads
Corker of a delivery to start with, but it moves too much! Length ball swinging in viciously. Pitches around off and flies down leg. Good take by Kishan

Maphaka gets Jaiswal! First wicket in the IPL for the 17-year-old! Pitched up on a full length outside off and shaping away from Jaiswal, who pushes at it. Ends up lobbing it straight to David at cover
Now he clears the infield on the leg side! 136.5kph short ball angling into Jaiswal, who clears his front leg and muscles a pull over mid-on
Slapped over point! Full outside off, Jaiswal carves it square on the off side. First boundary of the innings
Pitched up outside off, hint of swing away. Jaiswal looks for an expansive drive but is beaten on the outside edge
Jaiswal gets Rajasthan Royals' chase underway with a punch through cover point. This was back of a length, closer to off stump and Jaiswal picked the gap between point and cover for a brace
Starts off with a back of length delivery wide of off. Jaiswal wafts at it but is late into the shot. Quiet appeal from the slip cordon
